summary: Report missing replication workers and stale fleet exchanges instead of silently passing empty peer sets

replay.detail: Existing claims and membership are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persisted claim or storage schema change.

rules.detail: Configured fleet health requires live replication-worker and fresh exchange evidence; stored envelopes and redeemed admission alone do not establish health.

compatibility.detail: Fleet status includes actionable replication diagnostics, also surfaced through doctor, health and alerts.

downtime.detail: Diagnostics do not start, stop or restart services.

manual.detail: Operators with missing worker diagnostics must complete their service manager activation and verify the separately supervised replication worker.

recovery.detail: Existing join, leave and supervisor ownership contracts remain unchanged; no automatic fleet mutations are performed.
